**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 20 of the Redwood/Silverline agreement meets the INDEMN preferred position on every material term:

| Element | Where | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Vendor IP indemnity | 20.1 | Unqualified defence + indemnity for Customer, Affiliates and personnel; **no** modification/combination/specification exclusions — better than fallback |
| Breach of law / data breach / GN&WM | 20.2 | Tracks model language (a)–(d), plus bodily injury and tangible property damage |
| Procedure | 20.4 | Prompt notice, cooperation at indemnitor's expense, control of defence, notice failure limited to material prejudice, settlement-consent protections |
| Infringement remedies | 20.5 | Procure / modify / replace / refund; Vendor may not terminate unaffected Services |
| Customer indemnity stays narrow | 20.3 | Limited to unmodified Customer material used strictly as authorised and Customer's own unlawful use, with Vendor Technology / modification / combination / instruction carve-outs |
| Outside the cap | 21.3 → 21.1, 21.2 | Indemnification obligations are "Excluded Claims," so uncapped and outside the consequential-damages waiver — no 3× super-cap fallback needed |

No sub-elements fall short worth noting; the clause set is customer-favourable relative to the playbook.
